text: Reducing the power and energy consumption very, very significantly. Now, looking at our wireless networks, this is the graphical representation of a general wireless network. Then, different wireless network technologies will actually have different network architectures and different topologies. But this is a general example of the general wireless network. Where we have a network infrastructure that is wired, so here typically we have cables, okay, and then we have other possible environments where there are user devices that are wirelessly connected with a point of access. We may also have the so-called ad hoc network, as we will explain better in a minute, where there is no point of access, but actually the users can communicate directly with each other, and then one of the devices may be connected with a point of access. But we may have direct communication between the devices, and here is an example of two different.
